correctness.rationale: The squared pair norms are R+2rs c and R-2rs c. The weighted concave square-root maximizer lies inside |c|<=1 precisely for smaller/larger ratio t>=delta=|2a-1|; for t<=delta it is attained at collinearity. The exact scalar branches F_p(t) have unique max t=delta^{1/(p-1)} if 1<p<2; at p=2 a full optimizer interval t>=delta, while for p>2 equality in Cauchy and two-dimensional lp-l2 norm forces t=1 and the stated oblique angle. p=1 and delta=0 are covered, and differentiation produces left entropy h(delta^2/(1+delta^2))/4 vs right log(2)/4. I independently evaluated 137,781 (a,p,t,c) inequalities, corroborative not a proof.
